name: * Black Mountain
text: Guard. While Black Mountain is engaged with you, each other NINJA minion engaged with you cannot be attacked. ★ Boost: If an ally is defending against this attack, reveal this minion.

name: * Kirigi
text: Teamwork (NINJA). When Defeated: The defeating player either spends 2 resources of any type or shuffles Kirigi into the encounter deck. ★ Boost: If an ally is defending against this attack, this card gains [boost][boost] and this attack gains overkill.

name: Bo Staff Ninja
text: Teamwork (NINJA). Toughness. When Defeated: The defeating player discards the top 2 cards of the encounter deck and reveals the first minion with the teamwork keyword discarded this way.

name: Fukiya Ninja
text: Teamwork (NINJA). ★ This minion's attacks gain ranged. When Defeated: The defeating player discards the top 2 cards of the encounter deck and reveals the first minion with the teamwork keyword discarded this way.

name: Katana Ninja
text: Guard. Teamwork (NINJA). When Defeated: The defeating player discards the top 2 cards of the encounter deck and reveals the first minion with the teamwork keyword discarded this way.

name: Kusarigama Ninja
text: Patrol. Teamwork (NINJA). When Defeated: The defeating player discards the top 2 cards of the encounter deck and reveals the first minion with the teamwork keyword discarded this way.

name: Shuriken Ninja
text: Teamwork (NINJA). ★ This minion's attacks gain piercing. When Defeated: The defeating player discards the top 2 cards of the encounter deck and reveals the first minion with the teamwork keyword discarded this way.

name: Dancing Shadows
text: Each NINJA minion gets +1 hit point. Threat cannot be removed from this scheme while at least 1 NINJA minion is in play. ★ Boost: Reveal this card.

name: Countless Numbers
text: Surge. When Revealed: Shuffle each NINJA minion in the encounter discard pile into the encounter deck. ★ Boost: Resolve this card's "When Revealed" ability.

name: Shifting Corridors
text: Stalwart. ★ Forced Interrupt: When Shifting Corridors would activate against you, instead remove 1 passage counter from here and reveal the top card of the trap deck. If the last passage counter is removed from here, the players lose the game.

name: Into the Labyrinth
text: Contents: Shifting Corridors (A). Shadow Labyrinth, Dark Protégé, Deadly Contraptions, and Standard encounter sets. One modular encounter set (Ninja Swarm). Setup: Create the trap deck (see rulebook, p. 12). Set the Dark Protégé encounter set aside. Choose 1 random villain from that set, then shuffle each card linked to that villain into the encounter deck (keep the chosen villain set aside).

name: Into the Labyrinth
text: When Revealed: Place 10[per_hero] passage counters on Shifting Corridors (7[per_hero] instead in expert mode). Forced Interrupt: When Shifting Corridors would take any amount of damage, remove that much threat from here instead. Forced Interrupt: When the last threat is removed from this scheme, advance to stage 2A (the players win by advancing).

name: Chamber of Vile Secrets
text: When Revealed: Do each of the following: 1. Set Shifting Corridors aside. 2. Find the chosen Dark Protégé villain. Discard each status card, token, and attached card from it. 3. Reveal the chosen villain's side A (side B instead in expert mode).

name: Chamber of Vile Secrets
text: When Revealed: In expert mode, the villain activates against each player. Forced Response: After you or an ally you control thwarts this scheme, reveal the top card of the trap deck. (Limit once per round per player.) If this stage is completed, the players lose the game.

name: Whisper in the Dark
text: TRAP! Treat attached villain as an ELITE minion with 6 printed hit points. It gains: "Guard. Villainous. When Defeated: Set this minion aside." When Revealed: If Shifting Corridors is in play, put the set-aside chosen villain into play engaged with you, side A faceup, with this card attached; otherwise, set this card aside and the villain schemes.

name: * Lord Deathstrike
text: Patrol. When Revealed: If Shifting Corridors is in play, shuffle the top 2 cards of the encounter deck into the trap deck; otherwise, reveal the top card of the trap deck. ★ Boost: Put this minion into play engaged with you.

name: Dead End
text: Assault. (Basic thwarts against this scheme use ATK instead of THW.) When Revealed: If Shifting Corridors is in play, remove 1 passage counter from it; otherwise, place 1[per_hero] threat here.

name: Hall of Hidden Doors
text: When Defeated: The defeating player removes 5 threat from the main scheme. They discard cards from the encounter deck until a minion or side scheme is discarded, then reveal it. ★ Boost: Place 3 threat on the main scheme.

name: No Time to Think!
text: Peril. (While you are resolving this card, other players cannot help you.) When Revealed: The villain activates against you. ★ Boost: If this activation is an attack, this card gains [boost][boost] and this attack gains overkill.

name: Sudden Shift
text: When Revealed: Shuffle the trap discard pile and the top 3 cards of the encounter deck into the trap deck. Reveal the top card of the trap deck. ★ Boost: Shuffle the trap discard pile and the top 2 cards of the encounter deck into the trap deck.

name: Nervous Jitters
text: Attach to your identity. Forced Interrupt: When you choose the "Avoid" effect or the "Disarm" effect on a TRAP! card, name an encounter card type, then discard the top card of the encounter deck. If the card discarded this way was not of the named type, take 4 indirect damage and discard this attachment.

name: * Iron Monk
text: Patrol. Toughness. While Iron Monk is engaged with you, you cannot choose the "Avoid" effect on TRAP! cards.

name: Hall of Punishment
text: Forced Interrupt: When you choose the "Trip" effect on a TRAP! card, discard the top 3 cards of your deck. ★ Boost: Place 1 threat on the main scheme for each character you control.

name: Path of a Thousand Cuts
text: Every step is a test of resilience. Forced Interrupt: When you choose the "Avoid" effect or the "Trip" effect on a TRAP! card, take 2 indirect damage. ★ Boost: Deal 1 damage to each character you control.

name: Blinding Powder
text: When Revealed: Choose: • Avoid — Discard a THWART event from your hand. • Disarm — Discard 2 cards at random from your hand, then give a character you control a tough status card. • Trip — Deal 2 damage to your identity and confuse it.

name: Caltrops
text: When Revealed: Choose: • Avoid — Discard a DEFENSE event from your hand. • Disarm — Discard 1 identity-specific card from your hand, then deal 2 damage to an enemy. • Trip — Deal 2 damage to your identity and stun it.

name: Flame Spout
text: When Revealed: Choose: • Avoid — Discard an ally from your hand. • Disarm — Discard an ally you control, then draw 2 cards. • Trip — Deal 3 damage to your identity. Discard the top 3 cards of your deck.

name: Oil Slick
text: When Revealed: Choose: • Avoid — Discard an upgrade from your hand. • Disarm — Discard an upgrade you control, then remove 4 threat from the main scheme. • Trip — Discard 1 card from your hand. Discard the top 8 cards of your deck.

name: Poison Darts
text: When Revealed: Choose: • Avoid — Spend [energy] [energy] resources. • Disarm — Spend [mental] [mental] [physical] resources, then deal 3 damage to the villain. • Trip — Deal 3 damage to your identity and exhaust it.

name: Pressure Plate
text: When Revealed: Choose: • Avoid — Spend [mental] [mental] resources. • Disarm — Spend [energy] [physical] [physical] resources, then search the top 4 cards of your deck for a card and add it to your hand. (Shuffle.) • Trip — Discard cards from the top of the encounter deck until a minion is discarded, then reveal it.

name: Tripwire
text: When Revealed: Choose: • Avoid — Discard an ATTACK event from your hand. • Disarm — Discard a support you control, then remove 3 threat from a scheme. • Trip — Discard cards from the top of the encounter deck until a side scheme is discarded, then reveal it.

name: * Krahllak
text: Steady. ★ Interrupt: When Krahllak attacks you, you may place 1 corruption counter on your Creeping Corruption. If you do, Krahllak gets –3 ATK for this attack.

name: * Krahllak
text: Steady. Toughness. ★ Krahllak's attacks gain overkill. ★ Interrupt: When Krahllak attacks you, you may place 1 corruption counter on your Creeping Corruption. If you do, Krahllak gets –3 ATK for this attack.

name: * Krahllak
text: Retaliate 1. Steady. Toughness. ★ Krahllak's attacks gain overkill and piercing. ★ Interrupt: When Krahllak attacks you, you may place 1 corruption counter on your Creeping Corruption. If you do, Krahllak gets –3 ATK for this attack.

name: Dark Invitation
text: Contents: Krahllak (I) and Krahllak (II). (Krahllak (II) and Krahllak (III) instead for expert mode.) Heart of Shadow, Black Flower, and Standard encounter sets. One modular encounter set (Ninja Swarm). Setup: Each player puts a Creeping Corruption upgrade into play. Set the rest aside.

name: Dark Invitation
text: Forced Interrupt: When this stage would be completed, instead remove all threat from here and each player chooses: • Place 2 corruption counters on their Creeping Corruption. • Take 3 damage and deal themself 1 facedown encounter card. Forced Response: After Krahllak is defeated, advance this scheme to stage 2A.

name: Beast Be Praised
text: An inferno erupts in the throne room, punishing those who have yet to succumb to Krahllak's dark will. When Revealed: Each player whose Creeping Corruption has the OVERPOWERING trait discards 1 random card from their hand. Each other player discards a card they control from play. In expert mode, deal each player 1 facedown encounter card.

name: Beast Be Praised
text: [star] Forced Response: After resolving step one of the villain phase, each player chooses: • Place 1 corruption counter on their Creeping Corruption. • Place 3 threat here. If this stage is completed, the players lose the game.

name: Dark Shroud
text: Attach to Krahllak. Interrupt: When you or an ally you control would deal 4 or more damage to Krahllak with an attack, instead prevent all of that damage, place 1 corruption counter on your Creeping Corruption, and discard this card.

name: Fear Projection
text: Attach to Krahllak. Krahllak gains retaliate 1. Hero Action: Place 2 corruption counters on your Creeping Corruption → discard this card. Alter-Ego Action: Spend [mental] [mental] [mental] resources → discard this card. Remove 1 corruption counter from your Creeping Corruption.

name: Mark of the Wicked
text: When Revealed: You may attach this card to your identity. If you do not, take 4 damage, stun your identity, remove 1 corruption counter from your Creeping Corruption, and discard this card. [star] Forced Response: After attached hero makes a basic attack, place 1 corruption counter on your Creeping Corruption.

name: Pull of Power
text: When Revealed: You may attach this card to your identity. If you do not, take 4 damage, confuse your identity, remove 1 corruption counter from your Creeping Corruption, and discard this card. [star] Forced Response: After attached hero makes a basic thwart, place 1 corruption counter on your Creeping Corruption.

name: * Fist
text: Patrol. Retaliate 2. Hero Action: Place 1 corruption counter on your Creeping Corruption → deal 4 damage to Fist.

name: * Hellbride
text: When Defeated: The defeating player places 2 corruption counters on their Creeping Corruption, then heals 6 damage from their identity. Hero Action: If Hellbride has 2 or fewer remaining hit points, exhaust your hero → discard Hellbride. Remove 1 corruption counter from your Creeping Corruption.

name: * Retainer
text: [star] Retainer's attacks gain overkill. [star] Interrupt: When Retainer attacks you, you may place 1 corruption counter on your Creeping Corruption. If you do, Retainer gets –3 ATK for this attack.

name: * Snakeroot Elders
text: While there is at least 1 corruption counter here, Snakeroot Elders gains guard and patrol. When Revealed: You may place 1 corruption counter on your Creeping Corruption. If you do not, place 1 corruption counter here.

name: Veil of Nightmares
text: Krahllak's dark magic can tap into a person's deepest fears. Hero Action: Place 1 corruption counter on your Creeping Corruption → remove 5 threat from this scheme.

name: Submit or Suffer
text:
When Revealed: Choose: Either place 1 corruption counter on your Creeping Corruption, or remove 1 corruption counter from your Creeping Corruption and Krahllak attacks you.
[star] Boost: Choose: Either place 1 corruption counter on your Creeping Corruption, or stun your identity.

name: Creeping Corruption
text: Permanent. Setup. Max 1 per player. If there are at least 5 corruption counters here, remove each of them from here and flip this card. Action: Exhaust Creeping Corruption and place 1 corruption counter here → draw 1 card.

name: Creeping Corruption
text: Permanent. Max 1 per player. If there are at least 5 corruption counters here, you are defeated. Action: Exhaust Creeping Corruption and place 1 corruption counter here → draw 2 cards, then discard 1 card from your hand.

name: * Aka
text:
Quickstrike. Villainous. [star] Interrupt: When Aka would attack you, you may place 1 corruption counter on your Creeping Corruption. If you do, cancel that attack.
[star] Boost: Choose: Either place 1 corruption counter on your Creeping Corruption, or discard 1 random card from your hand.

name: * Tongue of the Beast
text:
When Defeated: The defeating player places 2 corruption counters on their Creeping Corruption.
[star] Boost: Choose: Either place 1 corruption counter on your Creeping Corruption, or this card gains [boost][boost][boost].

name: Binding Ritual
text: "He whom we serve shall reign supreme!" —Takashi When Revealed: Each player chooses: • Place 1 corruption counter on their Creeping Corruption. • Place 3 threat here.

name: Roots of a Black Flower
text:
When Defeated: The defeating player places 2 corruption counters on their Creeping Corruption.
[star] Boost: Choose: Either place 1 corruption counter on your Creeping Corruption, or place 4 threat on the main scheme.

name: Malediction
text: When Revealed (Alter-Ego): You may place 2 corruption counters on your Creeping Corruption. If you do not, the villain schemes with +2 SCH. When Revealed (Hero): If your Creeping Corruption has the OVERPOWERING trait, the villain schemes with +1 SCH; otherwise, the villain attacks you.

name: Invasive Thoughts
text:
When Revealed: Place 1 corruption counter on your Creeping Corruption. If it has the OVERPOWERING trait, place 1 threat on the main scheme; otherwise, take 1 damage.
[star] Boost: Choose: Either place 1 corruption counter on your Creeping Corruption, or take 4 indirect damage.
